display.title: Episode 550: The Rebbe of Chortkov and the Missing Tzedakah Purse
display.summary_short: Ahavas Yisroel in body and soul, Shema with a brother and sister, and the story of a faithful servant who claimed he took his Rebbe's tzedakah money so the poor would not go without.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi explains what Tzivos Hashem is about: Ahavas Yisroel as the Baal Shem Tov taught it, helping others both in body (food, clothing, tzedakah) and in soul (Torah and mitzvos). As the Alter Rebbe said, nothing pleases parents more than seeing their children love one another, and so it is with Hashem. After the Hakochainik march and an advertisement, a brother and sister lead the Shema, and Uncle Yossi shares how the boy climbed up to get his pushka ready before the show. Story time: the Rebbe of Chortkov discovers before Pesach that a purse of 500 gold coins set aside for the poor has vanished. His trusted servant Meir Anshel says he borrowed it and repays it all. Then a nobleman returns the real purse, which a maid had stolen. Meir Anshel admits he gave his own money so the poor would have food for Pesach. The Rebbe blesses him with wealth, and Uncle Yossi says his family became the famous Rothschild bankers, known for their tzedakah. The show ends with Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery.
display.lesson: Love and help every Jew, in body and in soul; a person who gives with his whole heart is blessed by Hashem.
